build_dictionary_from_files: build a vocabulary dictionary from a list of text files with configurable threshold and padding factor
setup_task_from_config: setup a fairseq task by loading dictionaries and initializing the task from an omegaconf DictConfig
build_model_for_task: build a fairseq model instance for a given task with optional scalar quantization applied
build_generator_with_search: build a sequence generator with configurable beam search, sampling, or diverse beam strategies
get_batch_iterator: get a reusable sharded batch iterator over a dataset with configurable max tokens and sentences
